card.name: Verbs leading into fetal harm findings
card.fires_on: The word just before a fetal harm term in pregnancy and animal reproduction study text, such as 'caused', 'cause', 'and' or 'fetal' ahead of malformations or toxicity.

modes.label: Cause verb before fetal outcome

modes.description: A part of the brand name CARBAGLU in a dosing instruction.
